# Zhouyi Xiaoxiao · 周易潇潇

> PhD researcher, University of Bristol — first-passage times of random walks and the evaluation of AI agents · R&D Scientist (AI), Yuexin International.

zhouyixiaoxiao.com is a live first-passage experiment run on one life: walkers leave Tianjin and search a luminous plate of 2021 to now for whatever you choose. Switch on the shortcuts actually taken, and the chart of arrival times splits into two peaks — which is the PhD result, and the way around this site.

So far. — as of 25 Nov 2026. English at https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/, Chinese (简体中文) mirror at https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/. This file is generated from the same content as the pages; facts link to the page that shows them. Also known as: Xiaoxiao Zhouyi, 周易潇潇.

## Highlights

- My first-author paper was accepted at the UK AI Research Symposium (UKAIRS 2026): AI agents can be prompted in romanised Chinese (pinyin), as long as homophones keep the key word in characters — poster, Edinburgh, 25 Nov — https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#papers-h
- I submitted a single-author paper to the physics journal Physical Review E in Jul 2026; its exact algebra is machine-checked in the Lean proof assistant: 46 theorems — https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#papers-h
- I released the public reproduction archive v1.3.0 for a second paper, still in preparation: code, proofs and records — https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#e-research_fpt-reproduction-releases
- Since joining Yuexin International in June 2026 I have built five AI systems that are now live: a model gateway, a governed AI platform, workplace connectors for AI agents, a daily briefing agent and a staff assistant — https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/#body-h
- I am one of twelve Early Career Enterprise Fellows for 2026, hold 13 teaching roles for 2026–27 and am a PhD student rep for Engineering Mathematics — https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/enterprise/

## Research outputs

- *Skipping the IME? Keyboard-Friendly Multilingual Prompting for LLM Agents* — Xiaoxiao Zhouyi, Yanzhen Li — UKAIRS 2026 (UK AI Research Symposium) · Emerging Research track · poster · Edinburgh — Accepted 11 Aug 2026 · poster #181, 25 Nov 2026 (2026-08-11). [Poster list](https://ukairs2026.eventsadmin.com/i/PosterSessions)
- *Geometry-controlled folds of first-passage-time bimodality under localized absorption* — Xiaoxiao Zhouyi — Physical Review E — Submitted to Physical Review E · Jul 2026 (2026-07-30). [Research atlas](https://zhouyi-xiaoxiao.github.io/valley-k-small/)
- *Programmable multimodality and saddle-node loss of reaction-time peaks under a fixed catalyst budget* — Xiaoxiao Zhouyi — Manuscript in preparation (2026-09). [Reproduction archive](https://github.com/zhouyi-xiaoxiao/prescribed-reaction-time-modes)
- *Spectral diagnostics and local fixed-budget sensitivity of critical points in finite encounter-reaction models* — Xiaoxiao Zhouyi — Working paper (2026-07)

## All chapters

- [01 · First Passage — PhD research: when a random walker first arrives](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/): Why one target can have two arrival peaks, and exactly when the second dies: my solo paper, submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal). Chinese: [首达——博士研究：随机游走何时第一次到达](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/research/)
- [02 · Skipping the IME? — First AI paper · UKAIRS 2026, the UK AI Research Symposium](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/): Can AI agents read raw pinyin (romanised Chinese)? My Edinburgh poster says: for routine prompts, yes; homophones need the key word in characters. Chinese: [跳过输入法？——第一篇 AI 论文 · 英国 AI 研究研讨会（UKAIRS 2026）](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/ai/skipping-the-ime/)
- [03 · The Engine Room — R&D Scientist (AI) at Yuexin International, a cloud-communications company](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/): Five AI systems I built since June 2026, all live: a gateway, a governed platform, agent connectors, a briefing agent, a staff assistant. Chinese: [机房——阅信国际 · AI 研发](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/work/engine-room/)
- [04 · On Stage — Brand design, trade shows and talks](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/on-stage/): I gave a cloud-communications company an AI-era face: a logo system, materials for two trade shows (MWC Shanghai, WWC Madrid), a 93-minute AI primer. Chinese: [展台——品牌设计、展会与演讲](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/work/on-stage/)
- [05 · Teaching — Graduate Teacher & Demonstrator](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/teaching/): I have taught since the first month of my PhD — for 2026–27, 13 roles across three schools: tutorials, labs, problem classes, marking. Chinese: [教学——研究生助教与实验课助教](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/campus/teaching/)
- [06 · Representing — PhD student rep & open-day ambassador](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/representing/): I am the Engineering Mathematics PhD rep (a year, now a second), a scholarship panellist, an open-day ambassador — and did seven minutes of stand-up. Chinese: [学生代表——博士生代表与开放日学生大使](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/campus/representing/)
- [07 · Map in. Traps out. — BioPath · Early Career Enterprise Fellowship](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/enterprise/): I turned first-passage maths into a product: BioPath tells farms where to put pest traps, proof attached. Early Career Enterprise Fellow, 2026. Chinese: [按图布点——BioPath · 早期职业创业学者](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/enterprise/)

- [09 · Westward — Silicon Valley, 2025 · an internship at LiveX AI, a Bay Area AI start-up](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/westward/): Summer 2025 in Silicon Valley: an entrepreneurship programme and a research internship at LiveX AI (4–16 Aug) — where my turn toward AI began. Chinese: [向西——2025 年夏 · 硅谷 AI 创业公司 LiveX AI 实习](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/westward/)

- https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/?q=<words> (Chinese: https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/?q=<words>) answers any question, but only in a browser that runs JavaScript: fetched without a script, it returns the home page unchanged.
- The passages it searches: [passages.en.json](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/passages.en.json) · [passages.zh.json](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/passages.zh.json). Compact JSON: `asOf` the build date; `p` the passages — `id` (c: chapter, e: record, p: paper, t: a term of the research Terms box, g: page), `t` title, `q` the quoted line, `date` as printed, `st` the status label, `until` the day after which `stx` replaces it, `href` its page, or `a` (e / r) for its anchor on its chapter page (#e-<id> / #r-<id>), `ch` the chapter number; `in` the passages each kind of question is answered with; `syn` and `homo` the synonyms and homophone sets. The full text behind each passage: [passages.en.full.json](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/passages.en.full.json) · [passages.zh.full.json](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/passages.zh.full.json) (`m`: id → text).
